summary: Samuel dies—Nabal rebuffs David and refuses to give him food—Abigail intercedes, saves Nabal, and gives David a present—David is pacified, Nabal dies, and David marries Abigail.
meta_description: Samuel dies—Nabal rebuffs David and refuses to give him food—Abigail intercedes, saves Nabal, and gives David a present—David is pacified, Nabal dies, and David marries Abigail.

footnotes.note14_b: HEB swooped upon (as a bird attacking).
footnotes.note22_a: What follows is a derisive term for “any male” (also v. 34).
footnotes.note25_a: IE Fool (insensitive, churlish person). Such a name must have been given him by those who knew him.
footnotes.note28_a: OR firm house; an assurance of descendants.
